newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's DBKom appoints Mannesmann exec.
newsitem.headline: Germany's DBKom appoints Mannesmann exec.

text.p: The supervisory board of DBKom GmbH, the German telecommunications group, appointed Peter Mihatsch, a board member of Mannesmann AG, as management board chairman, DBKom said on Tuesday.
Mannesmann is the biggest shareholder in a consortium that recently acquired a 49.8 percent stake in DBKom, the telecommunications division of German railway Deutsche Bahn AG.

Mihatsch is the chief architect of Mannesmann's telecoms policy, steering the company's rise from an industry newcomer in 1989 to what is widely believed to be monopoly Deutsche Telekom's most potent adversary on its home market.
Mihatsch will retain his position on the Mannesmann board.
Mannesmann is the industrial leader in the DBKom consortium, which also includes AT&T Corp and Unisource NV, the Swiss, Swedish, Spanish, Dutch telecoms alliance.
DBKom will be renamed some time in the future and be transformed into a joint stock corporation, DBKom said in a statement.
DBKom's previous managing director, Elmar Huelsmann, a former Alcatel SEL executive, was appointed as Mihatsch's deputy and head of marketing and distribution.
Volker Ruloff, managing director of Mannesmann Eurokom GmbH, Mannesmann's telecoms division, will become DBKom officer for finances and controlling.
Mannesmann's previous corporate network services company, CNI Communications Network International, and DBKom will merge, as previously announced.
